slug: 2024-11-19 HISP WCA develops DHIS2 EMIS for education data analysis and visualization in Togo

facts.fact: HISP WCA states DHIS2 was implemented in 2021 in interoperability with StatEduc, StatEduc collecting data and DHIS2 processing it and providing information products at all levels.

note: French translation of the 2022 article; the DHIS2 EMIS is said to be under review by the ministry.
